description: This file handles user registration and login initialization for the TestLink project. It includes functionality to verify configuration settings, initialize user input parameters, manage user sign-up processes, and notify administrators of new user registrations. It also contains utility functions for form processing and email notification.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: A class representing user entities and related operations, such as password validation, setting password, and database persistence.

classes.name: tlRole
classes.description: Represents user roles, with methods to retrieve users associated with a particular role.

classes.name: tlObject
classes.description: Provides database table details and utility functions related to database objects.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and fetches user input parameters from POST/GET requests, returning them in a structured object.

methods.name: notifyGlobalAdmins
methods.description: Sends email notifications to global administrators about new user sign-ups, based on configuration settings.
